mchenry-library:1340.note: Go in the library's main doors by the Global Village Café. That's floor 2; the room is one floor down.
steps: Take the library elevator, not the café elevator, down to floor 1.
Out of the elevator, turn left, then take the first left into the hallway.
That hallway runs between the elevators and the green wall, not into the TLC office.
Turn left again and go through the door marked “Exit Route.”
